operations.title: Nima repairs the D3 reflection and separates invariant scalarization from abelianization
operations.body: Correction and refinement: the first D3 packet used an abstract reflection satisfying the group relations but not the declared swap of sampled directions. The source-typed restriction is s=[[1,0],[1,-1]]. Both checkers were repaired and rerun; the commutator detector remains valid. The corrected action yields Q[a,b]^D3=Q[q2,q3], q2=a^2-ab+b^2, q3=ab(a-b); 7500 exact invariance checks pass and (q2,q3) separates all 169 bounded control orbits. This sharpens the conclusion: invariant scalarization is not group abelianization. A commutative scalar algebra can retain nonabelian orbit information. Graph events 1092-1093 explicitly supersede the flawed test evidence.
